challenge.description: Winter ends, but the forest doesn't get the memo. March and April are the killing months — the stores are empty, the greens aren't up yet, and the game is lean. The hungry gap.
challenge.name: Przednówek — The Hungry Gap

covers: Central Europe: beech-oak forest, creek valleys, allotment edges, and quiet ruins

beech mast grove: Mast country. The old beeches feed everything.
elder thicket: Cook the black clusters. The bush insists.
garlic bank: The whole bank smells of it in April. Sniff every leaf.
hazel coppice: Cut and regrown for a hundred years. The stools are older than the village.
mushroom hollow: Damp and dim. The mushrooms know.
oak hollow: The oaks drop dinner — if you leach it right.
old orchard: Someone planted food here once. The trees remember.
porcini ground: Where the roots run deep. Check the stems for the white net.
rose tangle: Thorns with a vitamin C pension.

name: Temperate Europe

ruins: A village school. The desks still stand in rows. Someone chalked the date of the last lesson on the board and underlined it twice.
A bus depot. The timetable behind cracked glass still lists routes to towns that aren't there anymore. A driver's lunchbox sits empty on the bench.
A corner clinic. The waiting-room chairs face a faded poster about flu shots. The medicine cabinet was emptied long ago — by someone careful, not someone desperate.
An allotment garden colony. The sheds lean and the fences sag, but someone's roses still bloom on schedule, for no one.

scavenge.name: Pickled cucumbers
scavenge.text: Dill and garlic in cloudy brine — that's how you know they're real.

scavenge.name: Dense rye loaf
scavenge.text: Stale enough to build with. Soak it and it's bread again.

scavenge.name: Canned sauerkraut
scavenge.text: Sour, salty, and full of the vitamins winter steals.

scavenge.name: Jar of honey
scavenge.text: Crystallized solid. Honey doesn't spoil; it just waits.

scavenge.name: Dried porcini
scavenge.text: Strung on a thread by someone who knew their mushrooms. Trust the string.

scavenge.name: Chocolate bar
scavenge.text: A little gray with bloom. Still chocolate.

scavenge.name: Canned white sausage
scavenge.text: The label promises Munich; the contents promise calories.

scavenge.name: Pickled beets
scavenge.text: Earthy and sweet. The jar sealed before the Burn and never looked back.

scavenge.name: Antibiotics (amoxicillin)
scavenge.text: A rattling bottle, seal intact. For bacterial infections. Read the label.

scavenge.name: Antiparasitic (mebendazole)
scavenge.text: Foil blister pack, unbroken. For worms and gut parasites. Only for those.
